name: UAlign
description: UAlign is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the alignment of Large Language Models in the Ukrainian language. It includes a moral judgment dataset with 3,682 scenarios and a dataset with 1,700 ethical situations, both with parallel English-Ukrainian text pairs for cross-lingual comparison.
reputation: A relatively new niche benchmark from the Ukrainian LLM alignment literature, with limited but growing use in cross-lingual safety/alignment evaluation.
notes: Contains sensitive ethical and moral content; addresses alignment evaluation in a low-resource language.
